heading: Simplified formula
text:
### Simplified formula [LNLS.7.1]

The T_wcet formula of [RTCT.12.1] / [RTCT.12.2] applies.  Under `linear_scan: false`,
the beta terms collapse to O(1) per join because LNLS.3.3 guarantees
J_max = 1 for every beta node:

```
T_wcet(linear_scan=false) =
    c_alpha  × Σ_s(α_s × T_s)                      ← alpha dispatch
  + c_join   × F_max × 1                             ← all joins O(1)
  + c_agenda × F_max × log₂(F_max)                   ← agenda heap
  + c_fire   × F_max × A_max × E_rhs                 ← RHS actions
  + c_ttl    × expired_max × log₂(N_max)             ← TTL heap drain
```

Where:
- `α_s` = facts of schema s matching any alpha node (≤ N_max)
- `T_s` = alpha tests per alpha node for schema s; each O(1) under linear_scan=false
- `J_max = 1` — proven at compile time by LNLS.3.3; not a deployment parameter
- `E_rhs` = max expression tree depth in RHS actions (join test expressions removed)
- All string operation costs are O(capacity) per slot = O(1) under LNLS.3.10
